fullFutureCompatibleQARow.aiNotes: Benzene and the neutral substituted product each have three alternating ring double bonds. Loss ofH+ followed by the restored third pi bond is correct; E replacesH. A base/counterions and electron-pair arrows are intentionally omitted from this compact orientation, and supplied authoredcases demand them independently. No hydride departure, retained aromatic sigma-complex or four-bond positive carbon is drawn. Native and316/360/680 cap448 viewed. E+,H/E at attackedC,ring+charge,two versus three double bonds,-H+,nonaromatic/aromatic labels are all recognizable at360. 680×383 is naturally under448px and uncropped.
